assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 full-screen environment background for the sanctuary invocation page in Sylve, a hand-painted 2D woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: the interior of an ancient forest sanctuary where guardian creatures are summoned. A circular open-air stone temple grown into a giant tree, elegant carved wooden archways entwined with roots, ivy and white woodland flowers, a softly glowing turquoise summoning pool and ancient engraved stone altar in the middle distance, delicate floating golden motes. Through the archways are misty emerald trees and a distant waterfall. Small warm lanterns and candles at the edges, an inviting sacred magical atmosphere.
Style/medium: polished painterly fantasy game environment, storybook realism, detailed natural wood and worn mossy stone, consistent with a cozy illustrated woodland deck workshop. Cinematic depth and beautiful hand-painted material textures.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9; symmetrical architectural frame and beautiful luminous central altar in the upper half. Broad calm darker stone floor in the lower half, visually uncluttered to leave room for two invocation choices drawn by the UI. No creatures or people. Environment artwork only.
Lighting/mood: diffused blue-green magical light, shafts of warm late-afternoon sun through the canopy, subtle amber lantern highlights, luminous but restful.
Constraints: no UI, no cards, no floating panels, no borders, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.
